digest.component_or_area: bridge state store (.bridge_state) schema and versioning
propositions: Three format changes to .bridge_state (A2 relocation to get_rotation.json, A3 scalar baseline normalization, A4-2 prev_snapshot narrowing) and one field deletion (A1 baseline_advanced_at) require documented rollback boundaries and mixed-version protocol.
Mixed-version reads use chronological max(new, legacy) to safely support concurrent old/new writers; first-wins is unsafe because it may select stale data from legacy path.

A2-2 deployment gate requires A2-1 merged on main, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host-probe refresh with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle—not elapsed time.
Bridge state remains committed on branch (not relocated off-branch) because ephemeral GitHub runners need durable state and epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation.
Format changes reduced marginal cost from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB post-A1, with 218/399 identical prev key sets (session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4).
Assignee excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape.
